title: Weekly sync prep - serving-runtime infra console - 2026-08-03
content:
Meeting: Weekly cross-team sync (serving runtime / infra / console) - prep notes and action items
Date: 2026-08-03
Owner (prep): Aisha Patel
Attendees (expected): Evan R., Priya K., Liam O'N., Mei L., infra oncall rep

Quick goals for this week
- Align on KV-cache eviction fix release timeline and rollout gating
- Confirm autoscaler tuning for Dedicated burst policy (QPS spike testing)
- Console: tracing -> correlate request IDs to job shards; small UX fixes for per-route latency chart
- Follow up on fallback routing policy tests (model variant compatibility)

Agenda (30-40m)
1) Quick round (5m) - 1-minute updates from each subteam (runtime, infra, console)
2) KV-cache eviction bug (10m) - current status, mitigations, rollout plan (Evan)
   - Note: reproduces for long-context 16k+ on fp16 quantized models; appears when prefix cache grows > 2GB on worker
   - Proposed short-term mitigation: aggressive prefix compaction + reduce max-cache-per-session to 1.2GB
   - Long-term: refactor shard bookkeeping to use incremental checkpointing (see CONFLUENCE-1287)
3) Dedicated autoscaler tuning (10m) - results from canary run, threshold adjustments (Priya)
   - Canary summary: 3 bursts in last 48h, scaled correctly but latency spike to 300ms P95 observed
   - Action: try lower scale-up cooldown (60s -> 30s) and test again in staging
4) Console tracing/workflow (5m) - correlate trace IDs to job shards + UI tweaks (Liam)
   - UX ask: add route filter on latency chart; expose trace link to trace viewer
5) Fallback routing tests and model variants (5m) - pass/fail matrix and next steps (Mei)
6) AOB + quick action-item review (5m)

Prep notes / things to bring up
- KV-cache: need a list of high-frequency customers impacted (SRE will share anonymized list)
- Autoscaler: check if scaling latency correlates with load balancer healthcheck noise (infra to confirm)
- Console: small patch for per-route legend ordering (low effort) - aim for hotfix patch by EOD Fri if no regression
- Routing: confirm model-variant compatibility matrix for rwd-7b-v2 and rwd-7b-quant

Unresolved questions
- Is the KV-cache compaction safe for multi-tenant workloads? (risk: compaction could evict someone else's hot prefix)
- Do we want to roll the autoscaler changes to Dedicated-only first or to hosted as well?

Action items (tracked here during meeting)
1) Evan to produce minimal repro for KV-cache eviction with heap profile attached - due 2026-08-05 - status: in_progress
2) Priya to run autoscaler cooldown A/B in staging (30s vs 60s) and post metrics to #infra-results - due 2026-08-06 - status: todo
3) Liam to add trace->job shard link and a route filter to latency chart, open PR and request review - due 2026-08-10 - status: todo
4) Mei to run fallback routing compatibility matrix across rwd-7b variants and document failures in CONFLUENCE-1287 - due 2026-08-07 - status: todo
5) SRE (oncall) to provide anonymized list of impacted customers for KV-cache issue - due 2026-08-04 - status: todo
6) Aisha to coordinate a short post-mortem doc template if KV-cache fix is rolled in prod - due 2026-08-09 - status: todo

Notes to self (Aisha)
- Bring up the regression alert thresholds we set last quarter; want to ensure they trigger earlier for latency flares
- Check GH-PR-987 for any unresolved comments re: console metrics extraction endpoint
- If autoscaler A/B looks flaky, escalate to infra lead for dedicated-policy override until fix shipped

Follow-ups (after meeting)
- Capture meeting minutes and paste into CONFLUENCE-1287 + link to this doc
- Update action-item statuses in the team tracker (JIRA board: JIRA-5421 epic)
- Quick post-meeting: ping SRE & product for customers impacted list, loop in CSM if high risk

Scratch/brainstorm (quick)
- Could use a lightweight sanity-check job that runs a synthetic 12k context inference every 6h in staging to catch cache regressions early
- Consider exposing cache size per-session metric in console (privacy: bucketed/anonymized)

--- end prep doc ---
